description: Plan a subway/metro trip in the Seoul Metropolitan Area (Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi) between two stations. Accepts station names in English, Korean, Japanese or Chinese, plus common landmarks (Hongdae, COEX, Incheon Airport). Returns lines to take, where to transfer, which direction to board, estimated minutes and fare. Works offline, no API key.

airport_express.description: Allow the AREX direct train (Seoul Station ↔ Incheon Airport), which needs a separate ticket. Default false.

allow_express.description: Also consider express trains (Line 9, Line 1, Suin–Bundang…). Default false; express data is less complete.

fewer_transfers.description: Prefer fewer transfers even if slightly slower.

name: subway_route
title: Subway route
